meta.name: English
ui.image_copy_failed: Copying did not work — open the picture and use the browser's “Copy image”.
ui.image_copy_needs_https: Copying pictures needs HTTPS. Open the picture and use the browser's “Copy image”.
ui.image_too_large: Too large to copy — download it instead.
ui.paste_hint: Tip: paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V (⌘V on a Mac).
ui.qr_hint: Scan it with the phone’s camera — works in your home network or over VPN.
ui.help_missing: The help text could not be loaded.
ui.clear_texts_text_one: All fields are emptied for everyone and reset to {n} field. There is no recycle bin.
ui.clear_texts_text_own_one: All fields are emptied and reset to {n} field. There is no recycle bin.
ui.clear_texts_text_other: All fields are emptied for everyone and reset to {n} fields. There is no recycle bin.
ui.clear_texts_text_own_other: All fields are emptied and reset to {n} fields. There is no recycle bin.
ui.share_text_hint: Share this text through a time-limited internet link
ui.remove_field_text: {field} is removed for everyone, content and all. There is no recycle bin.
ui.remove_field_text_own: {field} is removed, content and all. There is no recycle bin.
ui.clear_field_text: {field} is emptied for everyone. There is no recycle bin.
ui.clear_field_text_own: {field} is emptied. There is no recycle bin.
ui.changed_elsewhere: Someone else changed this field. Your text stays as long as you keep writing here.
ui.take_server_version_hint: Discards what is here and loads the current version from the server
ui.field_empty_share: The field is empty — there is nothing to share.
ui.copy_refused: The browser does not allow copying. The text is selected — press ⌘C or Ctrl+C.
ui.field_add_failed: The field could not be added.
ui.field_remove_failed: The field could not be removed.
ui.rescue_text: A field that still had unsaved text of yours was removed — by someone else, or while you were offline.
ui.conflict_text: Someone else saved this field while you were writing. Your version has {mine} characters, the one on the server {theirs}.
ui.conflict_safe: Nothing is lost while you decide here.
ui.field_gone: This field no longer exists on the server.
ui.server_version_failed: The server version could not be loaded.
ui.empty: Nothing here yet. Drop files here or press “Upload”.
ui.not_shared: not shared — only visible here in the LAN
ui.many_downloads_text_other: {n} separate downloads will start. The browser will probably ask once whether it may save several files.
ui.delete_single: “{name}” is deleted for everyone. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_single_own: “{name}” is deleted. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_many_other: {n} files ({size}) are deleted for everyone. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_many_own_other: {n} files ({size}) are deleted. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_files_text: {files} ({size}) are deleted for everyone, unfinished uploads too. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_files_text_own: {files} ({size}) are deleted, unfinished uploads too. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_all_text: All text fields and {files} ({size}) are deleted for everyone. There is no recycle bin.
ui.delete_all_text_own: All text fields and {files} ({size}) are deleted. There is no recycle bin.
ui.error_no_space: not enough free space on the server
ui.field_too_long: This field is too long to save — at most 2 million characters. Until it is shorter, it stays only in this browser.
ui.upload_interrupted: connection lost — it resumes on the next attempt
ui.drop_no_folders: Folders do not work — zip them first
ui.folders_text: {app} only works with single files. For a whole folder, create a ZIP first and upload that.
ui.folders_skipped: Folders were skipped — only files are uploaded.
ui.field_public_hint: A version of this field is reachable on the internet until {date}. Later changes are not included. Click for the shares.
ui.file_public_hint: Reachable on the internet — click for the shares
ui.shares_reachable_one: {n} item is reachable on the internet right now
ui.shares_reachable_other: {n} items are reachable on the internet right now
ui.shares_none_reachable: Nothing is reachable on the internet
ui.shares_intro: What is reachable through a link on the internet right now. Expired links disappear by themselves.
ui.share_ended: Share ended — the link no longer works.
ui.share_end_failed: The share could not be ended.
ui.share_text_intro: {field} ({words}, {chars}) is shared as it is right now. Later changes to the field are not included.
ui.share_file_intro: “{name}” ({size}) is shared for download. If the file is deleted here, the link stops working too.
ui.share_who: Anyone with the link gets exactly this content without logging in — until it expires or you end it. Nothing else is visible from outside.
ui.password_hint: With a password the page asks for it before showing anything. Do not send it in the same chat as the link.
ui.share_needs_name_title: Sharing only works through the name
ui.opened_by_ip: This page is open through an IP address — the internet address cannot be derived from that. Open {app} by its name and the link will be right.
ui.password_shown_once: Password — shown only now; only a hash is stored:
ui.link_manage_hint: Under “Shares” at the top you see how often it was opened, and you can end it at any time.
ui.error_text_too_long: The text is too long to share.
ui.error_hardlink_failed: The file cannot be provided for sharing (hard link failed — see the start-up log).
ui.call_none: Nobody else has Drop open right now — open it on another device, by the same https:// address.
ui.call_my_name: This device's name for the others
ui.call_https_text: Browsers only let pages opened over HTTPS use the camera and microphone. Open Drop by its name with a certificate (https://drop.…); the guide explains how under “HTTPS”.
ui.call_photo_saved: Photo saved to the shared files.
ui.call_photo_none: No picture to take a photo of.
ui.call_no_media: No access to camera or microphone — allow it in the browser.
ui.call_failed: The connection did not come about. Are all devices in the same network?
ui.error_call_too_many: Too many attempts in a short time — wait a minute.
ui.live_intro: Go live with video or voice only. Everyone with Drop open then sees a live tile and joins with one click. Picture and sound go straight from device to device, within your network.
ui.live_lock: Lock the room — nobody else can join
ui.live_alone: Nobody else here yet — the others see you as a live tile in Drop.
ui.live_invite_intro: Nudge someone who has Drop open — it rings briefly there, with a button to join.
ui.live_nudge_text: {name} is live and would like you to join.
ui.live_still_text: You have been alone in the live room for {minutes} minutes.
ui.live_still_closes: Without an answer it closes in
ui.live_closed_alone: Live room closed — nobody came in.
public.unavailable_body: It has expired, was ended, or never existed. Ask the person who sent it to you.
public.password_body_text: Someone shared a text with you. You got the password from the person who sent you the link.
public.password_body_file: Someone shared a file with you. You got the password from the person who sent you the link.
public.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Please try again in a quarter of an hour.
public.pin_body: Every new device asks for it once. Whoever set up Drop can help you.
public.user_pin_body: Your PIN — asked only once on this device.
public.copy_failed: Copying failed — please select the text
public.unknown_host_body: Drop does not answer to {name}. If that is your name for Drop: put it into WEBUI in the .env (on Unraid: Edit Stack → .env), then Compose Up.
